subject: Onsite lodging: VIP adjacency, early-arrival key plan, and sleep setup requests
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Hotel Sales - The Meridian <sales@meridianhotel.com>, Hilary Gomez <hgomez@crownevents.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-04-11T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Onsite lodging: VIP adjacency, early-arrival key plan, and sleep setup requests

Hi Hilary / Meridian team,

Thanks again for pulling the initial rate and block details for our ClientCorp executive workshop (May 19-21). A few follow-ups so we can lock the rooming manifest this week: 

1) VIP adjacency: We need two connecting suites (King + King/rollaway) on the same corridor for our C-suite guests (approx 2 rooms) with guaranteed adjoining doors. Please note these must be on a quiet floor (no live event access).

2) Early arrivals: Several attendees arrive on May 18 between 6–10pm. We need a key-handoff plan for arrivals before the front desk shift change at 11pm. Is there a secure key-safe or manager on duty we can hand a sealed envelope to?

3) Sleep setup preferences: We collect pillow type (feather/foam/hypoallergenic), blackout preference, and ambient thermostat range from attendees. We'll share specifics in the manifest but want your housekeeping team to respect "quiet housekeeping" windows (08:00–10:00 or after 18:00).

4) Master bill + incidentals: ClientCorp will put room & tax on master (rooming confirm list only) but most incidentals on card. Please confirm a single master-bill folio and whether we need a credit form per VIP.

5) Breakfast and dietary: We have two guests with gluten-free only + one vegetarian, plus one with severe nut allergy. Will the breakfast buffet have clearly labeled GF options?

Please confirm feasibility and any rate changes for the two suites, and attach a draft rooming manifest (xlsx or Google Sheet) we can iterate on.

Thanks,
Jonas

Jonas Weber
Program Manager, Events | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachment: none in this message

From: Hotel Sales - The Meridian <sales@meridianhotel.com>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-04-11T12:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onsite lodging: VIP adjacency, early-arrival key plan, and sleep setup requests

Hi Jonas —

Thanks for the clear list. Short answers below, and I attached a draft rooming manifest for your review.

• VIP adjacency: We can hold two connecting suites on the 7th floor (quiet executive wing). They will be guaranteed with adjoining doors once a deposit is received.
• Early arrivals: We keep a secure key-safe behind the front desk and the duty manager (name: Carlos Rivera) will perform after-hours handoffs; we can log guest names and pickup windows.
• Sleep setup: Housekeeping can pre-stage pillow options and set blackout shades where requested. We’ll flag the rooms as "Do Not Disturb" for the 08:00–10:00 quiet window if you instruct housekeeping via the manifest.
• Master bill: We can place room & tax on master. For VIPs we ask for a signed credit authorization (one per VIP room) — we can provide a template if helpful.
• Dietary: Our banquet captain will provide labeled GF/vegetarian stations; all food will be prepared in a nut-free station per your allergy note.

I attached: Rooming_Manifest_Meridian_v1.xlsx (draft)

Let me know if you want to hold the connecting suites with a tentative cut-off (we recommend holding until 2025-04-18).

Best,
Erin Thompson
Senior Sales Manager | The Meridian Hotel
sales@meridianhotel.com | +1 206-555-0124

Erin —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the draft manifest. A few clarifications / asks before we finalize: 

- Please hold the two connecting suites pending our deposit until 2025-04-18 as recommended. We'll wire the deposit by end of day Friday.
- On the credit authorization: can you send the PDF template and confirm whether a scanned signed copy via email is acceptable (we will not have onsite printing for some execs).
- Housekeeping: for the attendees with nut allergy, can you confirm the cleaning protocol (separate utensils, deep-clean of coffee station in morning)?
- Pillow inventory: We'll collect preferences and upload to the manifest. If you could pre-stage 2 hypoallergenic + 1 feather per VIP suite that would be ideal.
